assessment.clinicalSummary: Reviewed in clinic for atypical chest discomfort. History suggests a musculoskeletal origin; reproducible on palpation.
assessment.examinationFindings: Heart sounds normal, no murmurs, chest wall tenderness over costochondral junctions. BP 128/78.
assessment.investigationsPerformed: Resting ECG normal. Transthoracic echo: structurally normal heart, EF 62%.
diagnosis.diagnosisNarrative: Costochondritis; no evidence of cardiac disease.
management.managementPlan: Reassurance given. Simple analgesia as needed. No cardiology follow-up required.
management.recommendedFollowUp: Discharge to GP; re-refer if symptoms change character.
